hero.title: I build things until they work, then keep going anyway.
hero.lede: I'm Jakacraft — I write code, ship small tools, and spend more late nights than I'd admit debugging things that were "almost done" three hours ago.

paragraphs: I'm Jakacraft — a self-taught developer who got into this because I wanted to build the things I couldn't find, and stayed because I like the moment something finally compiles after an hour of staring at the same error.

Most of what I make starts as a small, slightly stubborn side project: a tool that fixes one annoyance, a script that saves me ten minutes, a game system that only makes sense to me. Some of them turn into things other people actually use.
When I'm not writing code, I'm usually taking it apart to see how it works, or figuring out why it broke.
